title: Grounding and Evaluation for Large Language Models: Practical Challenges and Lessons Learned (Survey)
findings: The paper, in its survey of bias and fairness, notes that new types of bias arise in LLMs and other generative AI models, including undesirable biases towards religious stereotypes, citing external research.
